description: Source file implementing tensor reduction operations such as sum, mean, max, and adaptive average pooling in the Torch JIT tensor expression framework.

methods.name: squeezeIndices
methods.description: Removes all indices from specified axes positions in a list of indices.

methods.name: computeSum
methods.description: Computes the sum reduction over specified axes of a tensor.

methods.name: computeMean
methods.description: Computes the mean reduction over specified axes of a tensor.

methods.name: computeMax
methods.description: Computes the maximum reduction over a specified axis of a tensor.

methods.name: computeAdaptiveAvgPool2d
methods.description: Performs 2D adaptive average pooling on a tensor.
